scope: Google-published camera samples / feature demos for the Pixel 11 lineup (launched 12 Aug 2026)

usage_terms.blog_google_image_library: https://blog.google/press/ (redirects to https://blog.google/image-library/) states: "Images on this page may be used for publication with credit: 'Source: Google.' For press inquiries, email press@google.com." The library currently lists no Pixel 11 assets, so this grant does not clearly cover the images below.
usage_terms.blog_post_and_store_pages: No image-usage or licence terms were found on the pixel-11-features blog post or the Google Store product pages. Treat as Google copyright; credit 'Source: Google' on screen and confirm with press@google.com before relying on them.
store_footnotes: camera-res: 'Reflects megapixels for camera sensor. Camera image resolution output may be less when using default settings.'
pro-zoom: 'Not available for all cameras, apps, or modes. Up to 120x results may vary.'
selfie-camera: 'Compared to other Pixel phone models. Reflects megapixels for camera sensor. ... Maximum field of view not available in all apps or modes.'
usage_terms.no_simulation_disclaimer: None of the source pages label these images as simulated or illustrative; none carry a 'shot on <model>' credit either.
